title: PHP 8.1 allows string keys in array spread. What does this print?
explain: Spread (...) copies the keys. For string keys a later value replaces an earlier one, so 'a' becomes 3. Numeric keys are renumbered.

title: An arrow function takes this from the place where it is written. What does Node print?
explain: In a method written with function, this is the object, so it prints 'hello'. An arrow function as a property does not get its own this. In a module or script it is not the object, so name is undefined.

title: A class can have an abstract method only in an abstract class or interface. What happens when you run this?
code:
<?php
abstract class Shape {
    abstract public function area(): float;
}
try {
    new Shape();
} catch (Error $e) {
    echo get_class($e);
}
options: Fatal error: cannot instantiate abstract class Shape
explain: An abstract class is a base only. You must create an object of a child class that implements all abstract methods. PHP stops with an Error when you try new Shape().
